title: How a Godly Man Handles Being Right When Everyone Else Is Wrong
caption:
Being right and needing everyone to know it are not the same thing.

State the truth once, then let go of whether the room agrees today. Micah 6:8 doesn't say walk right, it says walk humbly. You can win the argument and still lose the walk.

Let someone else take the credit sometimes. Correct in private. The real test isn't the group chat, it's the room where only God's keeping score.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #humility #wisdom
